basic_details.job_title: NABCONS Accounts and Procurement Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: NABARD Consultancy Services (NABCONS) has announced 1 vacancy for the Accounts and Procurement Assistant post on a contract basis. The engagement is initially tenable till 31 March 2027 and posted in Hyderabad under advertisement number NABCONS/CO-HR/20/PBCS/2026-27. Candidates applying for this post must be a Graduate in Business Administration or Cost Accountant or equivalent. Eligible applicants can apply online from 13 October 2026 to 19 October 2026. The selection process involves preliminary screening or shortlisting, an interview, and a medical test.

how_to_apply: Visit the official NABCONS website at www.nabcons.com or access the application link directly.
Fill in the required details in the online form for the Accounts and Procurement Assistant post.
Submit the application online on or before 19 October 2026 (Midnight).

rows.details: Project Management Unit for implementation of PM-MKSSY
Project Management Consultant for providing manpower to the Project Management unit for implementation of PM-MKSSY
Consolidated Professional Fees commensurate based upon experience and last drawn salary
Hyderabad (with travel requirement across the state and country)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in Business Administration or Cost Accountant or equivalent. Applicants require 5 years of experience in accounting, expenditure audits, and internal financial controls, along with in-depth knowledge of Government of India and State Government Financial Rules and Procedures. Good knowledge of Suppliers or Third Party Management Software, experience in collecting and analysing data, aptitude in decision making and working with members, capacity to work hard under tight deadlines, and excellent oral and written communication in English are required.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive consolidated Professional Fees based on experience, educational qualification, and overall suitability, commensurate with experience and last drawn salary. Tax liabilities under section 393(1) [Sl. No. 6(iii)D(b)] of the Income Tax Act 2025 and rules in force will be deducted at source. The position is hired on a contract basis initially till 31 March 2027, which may be extended based on project requirements and performance or co-terminus with the project period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NABCONS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official NABCONS website at www.nabcons.com or access the application link directly. Fill in the required details in the online form for the Accounts and Procurement Assistant post. Submit the application online on or before 19 October 2026 (Midnight).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: NABCONS will admit candidates based on information furnished in the online application and verify eligibility at the interview or joining stage. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview and may also be assessed for proficiency in MS Office and data management. The interview may be held in person or through virtual mode. The final appointment is subject to the candidate being found medically fit through a protocol of medical tests upon reporting at the place of posting.

faq.question: Q1. Is this position permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is on a contract basis as Project Based Contract Staff initially till 31 March 2027, subject to extension based on project requirements and performance or co-terminus with the project period.

faq.question: Q2. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: NABCONS conducts preliminary screening and shortlisting of applications based on the candidate's qualifications, suitability, and experience, and only shortlisted candidates are called for the interview.

faq.question: Q3. What documents are required to be submitted?
faq.answer: Self-attested copies of educational qualifications and experience certificates must be compulsorily submitted at the time of the interview, and original documents are required for verification.

faq.question: Q4. Can selected candidates take up other assignments during the contract?
faq.answer: Selected candidates shall not take up any part-time or full-time employment or assignments elsewhere or do any business during the period of their contract with NABCONS.
